items.title: Reddit Shares Pop Before S&P 500 Inclusion
items.summary: Two years after going public, social-media platform Reddit is joining the S&P 500.  It will replace AvalonBay Communities, a real-estate investment trust that is being bought by fellow S&P 500 member Equity Residential, creating a vacancy in the index.  Reddit will take AvalonBay's spot before trading opens on Aug. 18, S&P Dow Jones Indices said after Thursday's close.

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge as S&P 500 Inclusion Set for August 18
items.summary: Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) shares jumped 12. 3% in pre-market trading after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that the social media company will enter the S&P 500 before the opening bell on August 18.

items.title: Reddit Will Join the S&P 500. The Stock Jumps 12%.
items.summary: Reddit  will replace  AvalonBay Communities  before the opening of trading on Tuesday, according to S&P Dow Jones Indices, which oversees the index.  The change was prompted by  Equity Residential’s  coming acquisition of AvalonBay, a large owner of multifamily housing.  Reddit shares surged 12% to $177.74 in premarket trading Friday.

items.title: Reddit Stock Pops 11% on S&P 500 Inclusion Despite Google AI Traffic Concerns
items.summary: Reddit shares rose 11% on S&P 500 inclusion news, even as Google's AI Overviews pressure its search traffic.
